ideas.pitch: A regional language health triage platform for semi-urban communities featuring symptom checking and local clinic routing.
ideas.problem_statement: Lack of accessible, localized healthcare guidance and preventive care literacy in semi-urban and rural areas.
ideas.title: LocalAarogya: Multilingual Rural Health Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a localized impact angle similar to prior multi-language triage winners, targeting practical community-level problem solving.

ideas.pitch: A tool for small and medium enterprises to monitor carbon footprint metrics and generate sustainability reports.
ideas.problem_statement: Difficulty for local small businesses to track and comply with emerging environmental standards without expensive auditing.
ideas.title: EcoAudit: SME Environmental Compliance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on measurable environmental benefit and regulatory ease, matching green tech hackathon winning patterns.

ideas.pitch: An agentic system that detects anomalous data pipeline drops and triggers automated incident response workflows.
ideas.problem_statement: Data engineering pipelines breaking silently without fast incident triage or automated root-cause analysis.
ideas.title: DataGuard: Automated Data Lineage Incident Response
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases hard data-engineering logic and autonomous agent workflows that stand out to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first platform that indexes lecture and institutional meeting recordings into searchable transcript embeddings.
ideas.problem_statement: Inability of academic and local institutions to easily search through large volumes of unindexed archival video data.
ideas.title: VideoQuery: Unstructured Institutional Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on proven video intelligence and unstructured search paradigms from recent data hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision safety compliance checker that scans local site photos for PPE violations and safety hazards.
ideas.problem_statement: High rates of preventable workplace injuries due to lack of real-time safety monitoring on small-scale construction sites.
ideas.title: SiteSafe AI: Construction Hazard and Safety Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a robust working demo with immediate real-world utility, matching successful physical-safety hackathon entries.
